prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a stacked lumpy mustard-yellow jelly resting on the ground, three soft glossy round lumps piled on each other, the biggest at the bottom, a bright glossy sheen and a few thick drips running down its sides (attached to it). Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: no face, no eyes; the readable detail is the glossy stacked lumps.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, the top lumps surging forward toward the heroes as a low leaning mass, at most half again as tall as in the idle cell, the same three lumps, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, squashed down flat and wide, the lumps sagging into each other, quivering, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Squash and stretch the whole mass: stretch it far toward the heroes or flatten and bulge it, always one soft mass. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, a single soft mass resting on the ground line, a clear dark outline. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, eyes, a face, a mouth, bones inside, green colour, grey colour, puddles on the ground, drips on the ground.
